title: Make the advisory decode-cost check independent of its test selection
outcome: An isolated advisory cost check has the same meaningful verdict as the same check inside the broader memory suite, without hiding a history walk.
acceptance: Reproduce and identify why project_memory_advisory_is_constant_decode_at_scale counts two decodes in isolation but zero inside the broader memory suite; distinguish a pre-existing issue from current-memory navigation changes
Repair the responsible test setup or implementation and retain a meaningful bound that detects canonical memory-history traversal
